texts.zh:
在[from.GetName]上发现了丰富的石墨烯矿藏。这种碳的稀有同素异形体仅有一个分子厚，却拥有无与伦比的强度和导电性。

这种高价值的纳米材料在其地表自然形成，主要得益于这颗碳星球上独特大气的化学蒸气沉积。
texts.en:
Abundant deposits of graphene have been found on [from.GetName]. This rare allotrope of carbon is only a single molecule thick but possesses unparalleled strength and conductivity.

The valuable nanomaterial forms naturally on the surface here thanks to chemical vapor deposition inherent to this Carbon World's unusual atmosphere.

summary.text:
# 碳的同素异形体 / Carbon Allotropes

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:412; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1202 (extreme_frontiers.270)

## 如何开始 How it starts

荒芜或寒冷荒芜星球可能生成（5级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc；星球已有多个修正时权重为0）。生成时给星球添加 carbon_world 修正并通过 anomaly.6662 添加矿物矿藏。

Can spawn on a barren or cold barren planet (level 5, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc; weight 0 if the planet already has several modifiers). on_spawn adds the carbon_world modifier and a minerals deposit via anomaly.6662.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.270“石墨烯合成”：每月工程研究加成与 d_minerals_4 矿藏。

Single result extreme_frontiers.270 "Graphene Formations": monthly engineering research and a d_minerals_4 deposit.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
